heading: Privacy notice
intro: This notice explains how Kashphool uses personal information submitted through its website contact and sponsorship enquiry forms.

sections.heading: Who we are
paragraphs: Kashphool | North Kent Bengali Association is responsible for personal information submitted through this website.

sections.heading: Information we collect
paragraphs: We collect your name, email address, message, relevant sponsorship tier, submission time, source page and notification status.
Cloudflare may temporarily process the Turnstile response and connection information for spam and abuse protection. Kashphool does not store Turnstile tokens or IP addresses in its lead database.

sections.heading: How and why we use it
paragraphs: We use personal information to respond to enquiries, follow up sponsorship interest, administer enquiries and protect our forms.
Our lawful basis is legitimate interests: responding to people who contact Kashphool, managing sponsorship opportunities and organising community activities.
We use your information only for the reason you contacted us. We will not add you to a general marketing list without separate permission.

sections.heading: Who can access it
paragraphs: Authorised members of the Kashphool management team can access your information.
Cloudflare provides form security, application hosting and database services. EmailJS delivers enquiry notifications.
Kashphool does not sell personal information. Where providers process personal information outside the UK, the required UK data-protection safeguards apply.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
paragraphs: Enquiry records and notification emails are retained for up to 24 months, then deleted, except where a particular record is required for a legal or dispute-related reason.

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: You may ask for a copy of your information, correction, deletion, restriction or object to its use where applicable. We may need to confirm your identity.

sections.heading: Automated decisions
paragraphs: We do not use automated decision-making or profiling.

contactText: To exercise your rights, ask about this notice or raise a complaint, contact Kashphool first at
icoText: You can also complain to the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO).
